offering_description.value: Provides customer experience outsourcing and technology services, including customer support, sales, marketing, and digital engineering. It sells these to large companies, mainly in technology, retail, financial services and healthcare, and delivers them through its own global contact-center and tech-enabled service network.

primary_services.value: customer experience outsourcing; technical support; digital engineering; back-office processing; sales and marketing services

customer_segment.value: B2B: Large enterprises in technology, retail, financial services, healthcare, travel and telecom

end_markets.value: technology; retail and e-commerce; financial services; healthcare; travel and hospitality; telecommunications

revenue_model.value: service fees: Clients pay for outsourced customer experience and support services, often per agent or per transaction; project or contract: Multi-year service contracts and digital engineering projects for enterprise clients

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Runs customer support and back-office operations for client brands, sold to enterprises; software / platform: Proprietary technology platforms and AI tools used within its services for clients

geography_served.value: global: Delivery centers across many countries in the Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: Customer experience services, technology platforms and digital engineering, serving the same enterprise clients

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams selling services directly to large corporate clients

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Data privacy and security rules such as GDPR and client-driven financial and healthcare data requirements
